notes.title: Road To Early Access #5
notes.notes:
Hello Bird Lovers!

This is the fifth installment of the Road To Early Access series! Birding Simulator is getting bigger, and our team is working hard to ensure the game meets your expectations. This time we will talk about camouflage and rebuilt birds from the demo version.

[b]1. Camouflage[/b]

Camouflage makes you less noticed by birds. So you can get closer to it and capture even better shots!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/fef16e8c703ae8a8f350fbcbf0453f32de2b1104.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/4e2035526a0854d8f71e1b576ac9c09c8371b55a.png[/img]

[b]2. Redesign of several birds[/b]

We decided to redesign the look of 4 birds that already appeared in Birding Simulator demo version. What do you think about their present appearance? In our opinion, they look much better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/c741bd3db51638456252a0080e91889c4e4e600b.png[/img]

Thank you for your attention! We strongly encourage you to visit the [b]Birding Simulator Discord server[/b], where people boast of their most beautiful bird pictures!

[url=https://discord.gg/birdingsimulator][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/1e646dd11ef2e25e948343ac2c0d54c4061c8a4a.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Road To Early Access #3
notes.notes:
Welcome to the next installment of the Road To Early Access series. This time we have prepared more material about accessories for compelling bird watching.

[b]1. Cameras[/b]

There are many different types of cameras in the game. Each has another specification and application. Before setting off on an expedition, you must decide what equipment will be helpful for you under what conditions. You will also choose the right lens for specific camera models during personalization.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/633d85d9898ec460efd74178bdae318903c7bbf9.png[/img]

[b]2. Lenses[/b]

There are many types of lenses in the Birding Simulator which also differ in specification and application. One of the most important factors is the focal length. Below are the different types of lenses available in the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/5dd68666f8ef91519b3db9d7e7211e78a23f39e3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/d53c79241171ba2ef93056da2c4bb65d3b764fd6.png[/img]

Along with adapting the appropriate equipment, you can retrofit the camera with an additional teleconverter and lens filter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/702ee5571d97e2b298b7353c4e1255b3743e39d6.png[/img]

[b]3. Observation tower[/b]

We designed a new observation tower model that allows you to capture better footage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/48469ebcc7ddab824d882fd738ffcda09688a786.png[/img]

[b]4. New bird species[/b]

Beautiful animals, it's time to take a picture of them!

[i]Gray catbird:[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/823060c507cd3b1ffdd60e2f146e3ebabb4852c4.png[/img]

[i]Short-billed dowitcher:[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/8c0eb9a1f0b922f13822d73dd3514d2211049990.png[/img]

Another part of the Road To Early Access series [b]is coming next month[/b]!

[url=https://discord.gg/rSRrwbCCyH][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/1e646dd11ef2e25e948343ac2c0d54c4061c8a4a.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Road To Early Access #2
notes.notes:
Hi Birders!

It's time for a handful of more news that awaits you in Birding Simulator (Early Access version). Some things have been rebuilt, some have been reworked, and many others are relatively new.

[b]1. New camps[/b]

At this point, we have introduced five new camps where you can prepare for bird photography, rest for a while, or view the photos taken. There will also be places at the camps where you will have the option of storing photo accessories and personalizing your equipment.

[i]Camp #1[/i]:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/a928dd9c34352729e084d6614378525baf116eab.png[/img]

notes.title: Road To Early Access #1
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

After a long break, we would like to inform you what is happening with the Birding Simulator. 
There is a lot of it, so we are starting a new series called [b]Road To Early Access[/b], in which we will describe new functions and changes that occur in relation to the demo version.

[b]1. New map[/b]

Our team is currently working on a new and larger map. New terrain includes mountain roads, rivers, lakes, swamps, and many more. Additionally, the landscape has been given new textures. The vegetation has been modified, adding many different plant species. We will keep you updated on the successive changes to the map.

[i]Swamps:[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/7643eb11f4facdc201a9c58c7bfad604a76d94f6.png[/img]

[i]Grassland:[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/e5ba3f336d0fb5fbbf7d80efd2ba0b23cf10d6f0.png[/img]

[i]Waterfall:[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/7ea059190fa8bb3d9314a1457175436c84db4f3c.png[/img]

[b]2. New bird species[/b]

We are currently adding a further 44 bird species, of which 4 species present in the demo will be redesigned. Here are some examples:

[i]Blue jay:[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/e453f93c1d94faccc164a6c8972eddfde4df1229.png[/img]

[i]Cooper’s hawk:[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/21d029efc2b5c127a08d0224c56d86de60a31726.png[/img]

[b]3. Flight animations and bird behavior[/b]

Many animations have been redesigned, and many others have been recreated. We focused on rising, landing, and selecting the target route. Swimming is now one of the mobility systems. Birds exhibit different behaviors in certain situations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/94e6e9cb9d9f54e99369ade76204800f5431d527.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/a29fdccb7e5ccff2e24254e03bcc79a8661644d2.gif[/img]

We encourage you to discuss. Please post feedback in the comments section or on the Discord server (link below). Further on, other issues related to the advancement of the Birding Simulator production will be discussed!

[url=https://discord.gg/rSRrwbCCyH][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/1e646dd11ef2e25e948343ac2c0d54c4061c8a4a.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #11
notes.notes:
Hi Birders!

After the latest update, a compendium with detailed information about individual bird species in the demo version was introduced to the Birding Simulator. In addition to the English name, we have decided to add the Latin name of the species. Each bird will have a species description under the photo and general information such as: weight, size, habitat, activity, and many more. Some data are not unlocked at startup, for example: Diet or info about Eggs Laying. You can unlock it thanks to a corresponding rating for taking pictures of specific genres.

As you might guess, even birds have sexual dimorphism. We published tabs with the selection of the sex of the bird, for those interested, you can learn more about the differences between males and females of the same species. Below we attract two sample screenshots straight from our game:

[url=https://i.imgur.com/74b0UA5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/6f15acf2bf50eed7cf0467dc20b51eacb79e176d.png[/img][/url]
[b][url=https://i.imgur.com/74b0UA5.png]See full-size here![/url][/b]

[url=https://i.imgur.com/EMnfaz9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/4a06648a28eb75807f65ebac286e4be526c7d018.png[/img][/url]
[b][url=https://i.imgur.com/EMnfaz9.png]See full-size here![/url][/b]

 Of course, this is the end of our work, but only the beginning. We will inform you about the news that we will introduce to you. We encourage you to share with us your feedback at all times because it is beneficial in work. Feel free to comment in the Birding Simulator Discord and other social media!

[url=https://discord.gg/6nxrvpkCrd][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/1e646dd11ef2e25e948343ac2c0d54c4061c8a4a.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #8
notes.notes:
Hi Everybody!

In Birding Simulator awaits you an addictive and unpredictable story. However, choices and requiring challenges will accompany you throughout the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/8d01eb03d98f000eb35d8afa1292762fd5a3f339.png[/img]

The main character is Lucas. He is a hardworking and conscientious office worker who used to photograph. He gets a message from a childhood friend - Diana. Some corporation plans to raze the entire nature reserve to the ground and build a factory that will harm the environment. Lucas immediately returns to his hometown and meets all construction equipment getting ready for work. That will keep reminding you that your time is limited and a stake is high. You will take part in the growing conflict between ecologists and factory workers. Both of these groups have reasons to stand on one side. Help ecologists by fulfilling quests and taking the best pictures to show the beauty of that place.

‘[i]’Lucas’ relationship with the different groups will be significant during the game. We will have to deal with two factions, i.e., ecologists, eco-extremists, and a friend from youth. The player will perform tasks to stop construction work. We tried to show that values like friendship, beauty, and nature can be stronger than corporation. Everything depends on people's will and readiness to sacrifice[/i]’’

- [b]Wojciech Karolewski, Game Designer[/b]

Are you determined and brave enough to save the place where you grew up? How far would you go to stop the corporation? This and many other aspects await you in Birding Simulator!

Thank you for your attention. We hope that you are as excited as we are. Share your opinion and check our social media.

notes.title: Devlog #7
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
I’d like to invite you to the next part of Birding Devlog. This time we’ll talk about examples of bird species, that can be found in the game. Of course, there will be many more birds waiting for you (over 300 species), but it is good to know, what you will be dealing with. 

[b]Hooded Merganser[/b]
A species of medium-sized bird from the Anatidae family. Characterized by a thin beak, long tail, and fan-shaped, collapsible crest that makes the head look oversized and oblong. Inhabits lakes, swamps, and forest ponds. Finds food underwater.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/09c30e8ed706a370fb47bfaa383c463dfa200231.png[/img]

[b]Bald Eagle[/b]
A species of bird of prey from the Accipitridae family. It is a symbol of the United States. This bird can be found near open water. Bald Eagle makes nests on trees. Characterized by a white head, strongly curved beak, and sharp claws. It feeds mainly on fish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/a39b69ba6b0197c87d16262736d685f1f2fde278.png[/img]

[b]Black-Legged Kittiwake[/b]
A species of medium-sized bird from the Laridae family. Bird with white back and ashen wings. This species spends most of its life by the water. It feeds mainly on fish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/ccf7062a1a8035f50b3c8ccaf919e8f6d0e970a8.png[/img]

[b]Roseate Spoonbill[/b]
A species of big-sized bird from the Threskiornithidae family. Inhabits coasts, lakes, and wetlands. It is a pink bird with darker-colored wings. This bird makes nests on trees. It feeds mainly on fish and snails.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/3291de258bc8eb71ee473b248a79864d67856709.png[/img]

[b]Black-bellied Plover[/b]
A species of migratory bird from the Charadriidae family. Characterized by a black and white coloration. It makes nests in shallow depressions in the ground. It feeds mainly on insects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/378ff785542c70ff9498ecc1575dd203fb44a82c.png[/img]

A much bigger challenge awaits you. You should be well prepared and go on tour. What’s your favorite bird species? Let us know in the comments and necessarily check our social media. Stay tuned for more information!

notes.title: Devlog #6
notes.notes:
Hello, Gamers!

Welcome to a new episode of Birding devlog. Today I will tell you more about birds and how to find them. 

As I mentioned before, there will be a daily system that impacts on behavior and activity of birds and the occurrence of specific species which means that you have to consider it while looking for them. 

Birds can see or hear you and because of that, they can fly away from you. That’s why you need to be quiet and unseen. You can walk, run, jump, crouch, climb or slow walk but remember that every move makes noise. Wear camouflage clothes to be unseen. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/99875dd3c3ec88ac4834e8ee1f69224e6a40cf1e.jpg[/img]

[b]How to recognize birds? [/b]

At the beginning of your journey, you don’t know any birds. During observation and taking photos, you learn about them. There are 3 levels of knowledge of birds. 

1 Star - You can immediately identify the species of bird by looking at it through binoculars/camera.
2 Stars - A given species of birds leaves behind a trail that fades more slowly.
3 Stars - Once you have 3 stars, you can detect a species in the area by hearing its singing or other noises,

[b]How to find birds?
[/b]
In the beginning, you will find them during your walk. As you will know more about birds you will have more knowledge about where to find them.
 
You can also spot birds from lookout towers, hear them during walks, and lead their voices. 

That's all for today. See you next time and don't forget to join our Discord!

notes.notes:
Hello Bird lovers!

Today I will tell you more about our game. Let’s start!

Birding Simulator is taking place in Northern America. During the game, you will discover new places and thanks to that your map will be bigger. 

On the map, you can see where you are, where are camps, lookout towers, and demand areas where birds can eat, drink or sleep (but only if you discovered it earlier). 

[b]Camps:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/a0436cb79026fc288a2b2ad1608bc5a6516c4130.png[/img]
[i]One of the types of camps. [/i]

If you come back to the game you start in the camp which is the nearest place where you finish. There are such things as a bed where you can sleep and choose when you want to wake up and stash - a big chest where you can store all your items. 

At the camp you can eat, rest, sell your photos, buy new equipment and prepare for a new trip.

Camps are also fast travel destinations which means that you can choose any camp on your map and you will be moved there. 

[b]Lookout towers:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/fe2a85937573ccc9270052f9262f3fb06345a607.png[/img]

During the game, you can find lookout towers that can help you discover new places on your map and spot birds. You can also stop there to admire beautiful nature from a different view. 

And the last thing is the [b]Daily system:[/b]

Time in the game will be accelerated and will influence on few things such as:
[list]
[*] environmental appearance,
[*] Ambient sounds,
[*] Behavior and activity of birds,
[*] Occurrence of specific species.
[/list]

Hope you like that. Don't forget to follow our Instagram account @birdingsimulator to see our birds and join our Discord to talk with other bird-lovers - [url=discord.gg/EAeHk9WDra]LINK[/url]

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.notes:
Hello Bird-lovers! ːsteamhappyː
Welcome back to our cyclic Devlog where we present various aspects of the Birding Simulator. In this issue, we will tell you a bit about the map and the most important element of the game - birds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/82de80f6166abfffac7515466db18decc0d46e67.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Map[/b][/h3]
The map in the game will be diversified in terms of vegetation and terrain so that each species of bird can find a place for itself. We can find coniferous and deciduous forests there, meadows, wetlands, and others. You have to remember that nature is a dangerous place for birds, so they will avoid places where they may be threatened. For this reason, it will be hard to see songbirds soaring high above trees or waterfowls walking far from the water. There will be camps set up in several places on the map, where the player will be able to rest, buy new equipment, and prepare for the next trip. The player will be able to move between the discovered camps using Fast Travel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/efd3aedf4d74d4c77723fd3eca2f15036138aed2.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Birds[/b][/h3]
We plan to put up to 300 different species of birds in the game. These species will be included in 15 orders and 24 families.

During the day, each bird will try to meet its basic needs:

[list]
[*] [b]Eating[/b]
Due to different food preferences, birds will eat different types of food,
For example, hummingbirds will feed by drinking nectar from flowers, while omnivorous ducks will mainly hunt fish and aquatic invertebrates, but not only.

[*] [b]Drinking[/b]
Like humans, birds need water to live, but unlike us, they cannot suck water down their throats.
In most cases, the birds must tilt their head back after drawing water into their mouths to let the gravity drain the water into the stomach. The exceptions are pigeons and doves, which can drink like humans.

[*] [b]Sleeping[/b]
After an exhausting day, each bird will want to take a nap to regenerate,
With predators in mind, each species sleeps in a place where it feels safest,
For example, ducks feel safest when sleeping in the water, woodpeckers in recesses of trees. On the other hand, eagles, due to the lack of natural threats in the air, sleep in a tree under the open sky.[/list]

Not only the appearance of the birds attracts the attention of birders all over the world. Also the sounds they seem to make can fascinate the audience. Birds sing for a variety of reasons, but by observation, we can determine why they do it:

[list]
[*] [b]Warning calls[/b] - sharp and piercing warning signals used by birds when they feel threatened and want to alert comrades of the danger,

[*] [b]Contact calls[/b] - they are characterized by a moderately strong chirping, but not as piercing as warning calls, used, for example, to determine the position of other birds in a flock, in territories, inhabited by different species of birds, contact calls are used to distinguish individual species,

[*] [b]Mating calls[/b] - often complicated and elaborate melodies, sung mainly by males during the mating season, which is to attract an individual of the opposite sex,
[/list]

There are more types of calls and songs, but we want to leave them to players to discover for themselves. Not all bird species can call and sing. For example, eagles and gulls make sounds like caws, clucks, or screeches.

For birds to survive, they must be careful of the surrounding threats. They consider humans to be one of such threats. When you get too close, there is a very good chance that the bird will notice you and fly away, which can make taking a photo very difficult. Birds can detect us not only by their eyesight but by acting too loud, birds can hear us, consider it a threat, and fly away. Stealth allows you to get much closer to the bird and find a better position to take the photo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/23116f8b2763849256a170bde6d9921e6c5f2b62.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Day and Night system[/b][/h3]
When night falls and most species of birds go to sleep, not all birds are daytime creatures. Birds like owls and nighthawks are most active at night. Due to poor lighting at night, detecting birds may be a bit difficult, so when trying to take photos after dusk, it will be worth taking a thermal camera with you and arming the camera with a flash. Be sure to use the flash occasionally or only when necessary, too much light can limit your ability to hunt night birds.

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the Birding Simulator Dev Team! We decided to start introducing you to our production by answering a few key questions. In the Devlog series, we want to show you what working on the project looks like, summarizing the activities so far.

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/rKx67QQ0yQFvSmwtCs/giphy.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Game overview[/b][/h2]
[u][b]What kind of game is it?[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Simulator with storyline elements
[/list]
[u][b]Who this game is intended for?[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Everyone who loves birding and wildlife photography 
[/list]

[h2][b]Game Contents[/b][/h2]
[h3]Location[/h3]
[list]
[*] The map is based on the East Coast of the United States. Terrain will be highly diversified allowing as many bird species as possible to appear in our game.
[/list]

[h2][b]Birds[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]     We plan to introduce up to 300 bird species from 24 families and 15 orders,
[*]     Each bird will have it’s own consciousness and needs that will be fulfilled during daily routines,
[*]     Depending on the species’ social aspect, birds will interact with each other more or less frequently,
[*]     Aware of the danger, birds will be able to spot or hear players and, in case of a real threat, they will try to escape from him.
[/list]
[h2][b]Items[/b][/h2]
[h3]Smartphone [/h3]
[list]
[*]     Player’s phone serves as minimap and allows to communicate with other NPCs,
[/list]
[h3]Binoculars[/h3]
[list]
[*]     Can help the player with identifying birds’ species and allow to track birds for a short time,
[/list]
[h3]Thermal Camera[/h3]
[list]
[*]     Its main purpose is to help player notice and track birds at night
[/list]
[h3]Camo Tents[/h3]
[list]
[*]     While observing in a tent, the player is unable to move, but is invisible to birds,
[/list]
[h3]Clothing[/h3]
[list]
[*]     Players may become less visible or audible by equipping correct clothing for specific environments.
[/list]
[h3]Photo Cameras[/h3]
[list]
[*]     The main game item that allows the player to take photos which will help him earn money and progress in the story,
[*]  The game will have to offer many camera models and even more subparts that will affect photo results: [i]Lens, Lens Filters, Teleconverters, Flashes, Grips.[/i]
Are you not familiar with operating photo cameras? Don’t worry each camera will have an Automatic mode that will choose the best parameters for current light conditions,
[*] Those who know photography basics will have the opportunity to modify camera settings to achieve the desired photo effect,
[/list]

[h2][b]Storyline[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]     The game will also include an intricate plot in which players will try to defend bird habitats from anyone who will try to disturb them.
[*]     Game’s storyline is not required to meet and photograph every bird species.
[/list]
[b]
Remember to join our community and keep up to date with more devlogs![/b]
